[[Martial]] is the adjective describing those [[Guild Wars]] [[profession]]s that primarily rely on [[attack skill]]s and [[physical attack]]s; they also have enough [[armor]] to protect themselves in [[melee]]. 

All martialists are proficient with [[martial weapon]]s and are vulnerable to [[anti-martial tactics]]. 

== Martial details ==
* '''Armor:''' the [[basic armor]] of all martials have 70 and 80 [[armor rating]].
* '''Weaponry:''' martial professions use [[axe]]s, [[bow]]s, [[daggers]], [[hammer]]s, [[scythe]]s, [[spear]]s, [[sword]]s, [[shield]]s, and [[pet]]s. 
** Martial weapon damage scales with both level and attribute points spent into mastery of the specific weapon.
* '''Professions:'''
** [[Core]]: {{w}} [[Warrior]]s, {{r}} [[Ranger]]s 
** [[Factions]]: {{a}} [[Assassin]]s 
** [[Nightfall]]: {{d}} [[Dervish]]es, {{p}} [[Paragon]]s

== Pseudo-martial professions ==
Some of the caster professions can perform parallel functions as the martial professions by using specific builds:
* {{me}} [[Mesmer]]s can use [[Illusionary Weaponry]]-based builds.
* {{rt}} [[Ritualist]]s can use [[Spirit's Strength]]-based builds.
* {{e}} [[Elementalist]]s can [[tank]] by using armor-boosting [[Earth Magic]] skills.

== Notes ==
* The opposite of martial professions are the five [[caster]] professions.
* The game's [[AI|artificial intelligence]] identifies a martial character as those wielding [[martial weapon]]s. This affects the type of skill heroes, henchmen, and foes will use on allies and opponents. For example, Mesmers will cast [[Chaos Storm]] on assassins equipped with a staff and paragons carrying a bundle, but not on elementalists carrying a spear.
